novel_features.name: Concept chronology
novel_features.description: See how Seykota's thinking on a concept appears across 20 years — a year-ordered list of every FAQ month, TSP section, and risk-essay passage that matches your query.

novel_features.name: Coin-Toss simulator
novel_features.description: Monte-Carlo the risk essay's own Coin-Toss / fixed-fraction model with your win rate, payoff, and bet fraction — reports median terminal equity, probability of ruin, max drawdown, and the optimal-f comparison.

novel_features.name: Lake Ratio calculator
novel_features.description: Compute Seykota's Lake Ratio — the area of drawdown 'water' divided by the area under the equity 'land' — over your own equity curve from a CSV or stdin.

novel_features.name: FAQ contributor index
novel_features.description: List everyone who wrote into Ed's FAQ with how many months each appears in, or pass a name to see exactly which months they show up in.

novel_features.name: Metric explainer
novel_features.description: For a named risk metric — heat, Kelly K, the Uncle Point, the Lake Ratio, the Timid/Bold trader rules — print the exact passage from the risk essay that defines it plus the calculator subcommand that runs it.

novel_features.name: Citation-formatted search
novel_features.description: Search the archive and get back one ready-to-paste citation per hit — source, date or section, snippet, and URL — or BibTeX entries.
